comment: Spordle stores names in ALL CAPS. to_data.py title-cases them and handles Mac/Mc/Le/La/D'/St- prefixes, but the correct spelling of an Acadian surname is person-specific (LeBlanc vs Leblanc). Put exact display spellings here, keyed by the captured ALL-CAPS name. These win over the automatic rules.  Confirmed against the printed card art in assets/photos, which carries the real spelling including accents.
